top_findings: NEW SINCE NOV 6: Google Search Console verification (<meta name="google-site-verification">) is now live across all 24 URLs, Speculation Rules (prefetch + prerender) score 100/100, and Agentic Readiness passes 11/11 checks (ARD 1.0 + WebMCP).

findings.title: Forced Arabic Client-Side Redirect Bounces Human Visitors Off /en/* Deep Links
findings.description: Because Admin 'Default website language' is set to Arabic (mode = 'ar'), includes/header.php redirects first-time human visitors landing on /en/* URLs (e.g., from an English Google SERP result) to /ar/*.
findings.recommendation: Set Default website language to 'Automatic' in /admin, or update includes/header.php so forced language only applies on root entry and never overrides explicit /en/* or /ar/* deep links.

findings.title: Add Bing Webmaster Verification Token (msvalidate.01)

findings.recommendation: Import your verified GSC property into Bing Webmaster Tools or paste msvalidate.01 in Admin -> Settings -> Google & Social.

findings.title: Uncached Origin TTFB Variance on Shared Hosting (574ms–6,052ms)
findings.description: Setting Cache-Control: public, max-age=0, must-revalidate fixed CDN language caching bugs on /, but causes occasional 2.5s–6.0s TTFB spikes on cold PHP hits for /en/* and /ar/*.
findings.recommendation: Keep max-age=0 on root /, while allowing s-maxage=300 CDN caching on deterministic /en/* and /ar/* URLs once client-side forced redirect is scoped to root.
